recognize_zh: HHV8 染色較高倍下，散在的大型細胞核呈棕色、帶有斑點狀（顆粒狀）的核內著色，細胞質不著色，這種點狀 LANA 核型態是 HHV8 感染的特徵。
features: Scattered cells with nuclear HHV8 (LANA-1) staining in loose stroma
Characteristic speckled/stippled granular nuclear pattern in many positive cells
Positive nuclei are enlarged and round to oval; cytoplasm unstained
Negative stromal and inflammatory nuclei with blue counterstain
Edematous stroma with irregular clear spaces
describe_en: HHV8 (LANA-1) immunohistochemistry shows numerous scattered enlarged cells with nuclear staining, many displaying the characteristic speckled or granular nuclear pattern, while stromal and small inflammatory cells are negative. Stippled nuclear LANA staining is specific for HHV8 latent infection. In a CD20-negative, MUM1-positive, immunoglobulin-negative large-cell lymphoma, this finding is consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Kaposi sarcoma shows the same LANA pattern in spindle cells lining vascular slits that are CD31/ERG-positive rather than CD45/MUM1-positive lymphoid cells.
In MCD, LANA-positive plasmablasts are few and confined to follicle mantle zones, not diffusely infiltrating stroma.
Morphology and phenotype overlap, but plasmablastic lymphoma is LANA-negative.
